other_conditions: Applicant must be unemployed and of Kerala origin
Post‑graduation with at least 60% marks in Basic/Applied Science or Professional courses
Valid Ph.D registration in a Kerala academic/research institution (STEAM streams) with completed coursework
Career break of at least 6 months during Ph.D programme due to maternity or other valid reasons
Must not have completed 4 years as on the date of Ph.D registration
Cannot be receiving any fellowship or grant from any other source for the Ph.D programme
Must provide an undertaking that no other financial assistance is being received simultaneously
Research must be supervised by a Scientist Mentor who is a regular faculty/staff with at least 5 years of service remaining before retirement
Research Fellow must not collaborate with a foreign party without prior Council approval
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹22,000 (+10% HRA) for the first two years and ₹25,000 (+10% HRA) in the third year, plus an annual contingent grant of ₹20,000.
